class.name: g1_hardware_interface/G1ArmSdkSystem
class.description: ros2_control System bridging the G1's 14 arm joints onto Unitree's weight-blended rt/arm_sdk DDS channel. The legs remain under onboard control, while the waist is held internally by this hardware interface during arm control. The hands are handled separately. See the package README for the safety/ramp model.
